Use the teacher track to choose and try a question. The [developer track](#for-developers) keeps replay details and adaptation issues together.

## For teachers

These are 35 unchanged STACK XML questions from the upstream library. **The 23 questions whose authored tests passed on every replayed seed have interactive cards.** Each question has a local XML download and an observed result. One additional presentation teaching copy shows a matrix question whose original HTML is unsupported. Other originals remain available with the observed mismatch or unsupported feature shown explicitly.

In this snapshot, **23 pass their author tests**, **1 has a test mismatch**, and **11 cannot be fully checked here**. The [replay record](questions/corpus/baseline.json) gives the tested variants and exact results.

The [worked matrix examples](examples.qmd#find-a-nonidentity-matrix-with-determinant-one) include determinant, basis and positive-definiteness tasks. They all use named functions in a [supplied Python checker file](questions/matrix-checkers.py). These authored examples are separate from the unchanged exports and their baseline counts. See [Python answer tests](docs/python-checker-api.qmd).

### Five matrix-input problems

The four elementary-row-operation problems below run directly from unchanged official exports: [row 2 plus a multiple of row 3](#linearalgebra-elementary-1), [row 1 plus a multiple of row 3](#linearalgebra-elementary-2), [row 2 plus a multiple of row 1](#linearalgebra-elementary-3), and [row 1 minus a multiple of row 2](#linearalgebra-elementary-4). Together their original tests pass all 24 recorded seed/case combinations. Each uses a fixed 3 by 3 matrix editor and whole-matrix algebraic equivalence; no automatic cell partial credit is added.

The fifth asks learners to write a system of three linear equations as a coefficient matrix and a column vector. Its original XML is [preserved unchanged](questions/corpus/7-3-26-(Write-sim-eqns-with-matrices).xml) and remains blocked by an unsupported inline HTML style. This explicitly attributed presentation teaching copy removes that style and closes its list; variables, answers, PRT and authored qtest are unchanged. Its original qtest passed on the recorded Moodle seeds; the SymPy proposals below run their own qtests. This is a presentation adaptation, not evidence that the original export runs unchanged.

```{.stack-question}
#| file: questions/corrected/7-3-26-(Write-sim-eqns-with-matrices).xml
#| question: 7.3.26 (Write sim. eqns. with matrices) (presentation teaching copy)
#| label: corpus-matrix-system
#| review: true
```

[Download presentation teaching XML](questions/corrected/7-3-26-(Write-sim-eqns-with-matrices).xml) · [Adaptation and licensing](questions/corrected/README.md)

## For developers

### Authored test mismatches

These cases disagree with expectations authored in the XML and are kept out of the interactive gallery. Reviewed causes are named below; an authored-test mismatch alone does not identify whether the cause is the port or the original question. The [baseline JSON](questions/corpus/baseline.json) retains the exact expected and observed results.

#### AlgMap-8.10 {#algmap-8-10}

**Upstream authoring bug in the PRT.** At the failing variant, `a=8`, `b=9`, `c=2`, and `d=3`, so the correct answer is `8*(t+y)/2 + 9*(t+y)/3 = 7*(t+y)`. Both authored model answers therefore have no fraction operator. The only full-credit branch requires `SingleFrac`, which rejects this product; every later branch awards zero. Authored tests 1 and 2 nevertheless expect full credit. The pinned native STACK test also rejects `7*(t+y)` under `SingleFrac`. The port's random choices expose a latent assumption in the original question; this diagnosis uses the fixed values above, rather than assuming Maxima generates those values for the same seed.

Algebra Refresher / 08 Algebraic fractions · **2 failed of 12 replayed seed/case combinations.** For seed `1856951054`, case `1`, input `ans = (7*(t + y))`: `prt1` expected score `1.0` and answer note `1-0-T`, but produced score `0.0` and answer note `1-0-F | 1-1-F`.

[Download original XML](questions/corpus/AlgMap-8-10.xml) · [Full replay](questions/corpus/baseline.json)

### How this gallery was checked

The [reproducible baseline](questions/corpus/baseline.json) records **23 passed**, **1 with test mismatches**, and **11 blocked** (3 at import, 8 while preparing a variant). It retained **82 authored test cases** and replayed **162 seed/case combinations** across 24 prepared questions; 2 combinations disagreed. Results for these variants do not establish complete STACK/Maxima agreement.

### Sources

These unchanged questions come from the [STACK question library](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack) at its [pinned revision](https://github.com/maths/moodle-qtype_stack/commit/10d323311b7f39fb7b092dd10ce75f7d8632f525) and retain [CC BY-SA 4.0](questions/corpus/COPYING.txt). The [source manifest](questions/corpus/manifest.json) links every question to its exact upstream file. The [presentation teaching copy](questions/corrected/README.md) records its limited HTML change and licensing; three other [corrected teaching copies](questions/corrected/README.md) record their mathematical or grading changes.
